creative-stone.profile: offline creative, flat overworld, seed 0, fresh empty player
creative-stone.comparison: Ordered block_change packets at target and digging acknowledgments for each sequential action; initial 46-slot inventory contents.
excluded: other packet types and other block positions
wall-clock timing, world age and keepalive nonces
random UUIDs, sounds, particles and RNG consumption
Java save import (native requires complete source provenance for gameplay)
creative-stone.control: Same logical flat block world and seed 0: Java uses the declared flat generator, native uses its fresh production flat backend. Client compares SHA-256 of all 98,304 target-chunk block states plus hashed world seed before acting. Java weather/daylight/mob/random ticks are disabled; native default clock remains active. Each action waits for its update and acknowledgment; native has no tick freeze.
